Harry's Oil Rig MessArmageddonDrilling for dessert.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersAJ and Grace's honey animal crackersCrisp honey butter cookies cut into small animal shapesHow to make it125g butter, soft80g caster sugar2 tbsp honey250g plain flourHeat the oven to 170°C. Beat the butter, sugar and honey, then mix in the flour to a dough.Roll thin and cut with small animal cutters.Bake until pale golden.Cool on a rack and pile into a bowl.Oil rig jerkyBeef marinated overnight in soy, brown sugar and pepper, dried low and slowHow to make it600g beef topside80ml soy sauce2 tbsp brown sugar2 tsp black peppercorns, crackedSlice the beef thin across the grain.Marinate with the soy, sugar and cracked black peppercorns overnight in the fridge.Lay on racks and dry in a low oven with the door ajar until leathery but bendy.MainsRib eye with onion gravy and mashSeared rib eyes, buttery mashed potato and caramelised onion gravyHow to make it1kg potatoes100g butter100ml full cream milk2 brown onions, sliced1 tbsp plain flour400ml beef stock4 rib eye steaks1 tbsp vegetable oilBoil the potatoes until tender, then mash with most of the butter and the milk.Cook the onions in butter until deep golden, stir in the flour, then add the stock and simmer.Sear the steaks hard in the vegetable oil in a smoking pan.Rest the steaks and pour the gravy over.Oil rig chuck chilli with cornbreadHearty and red, with cornbreadHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef chuck chunks braised with onion, garlic, chilli, cumin, tomato and kidney beans until tender, with sour cream and warm buttered cornbread.Brown 1.2kg beef chuck in 3cm chunks in batches.Add 2 diced onions and 4 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes, then 2 tbsp chilli powder, 2 tsp cumin and 2 tbsp tomato paste.Add 800g crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock, cover and braise at 150°C for 2.5 hours.Stir in a drained 400g tin kidney beans for the last 20 minutes.Bake cornbread mix in a hot buttered pan at 200°C for 20 minutes.Serve with sour cream.SweetsAnimal crackers and creamAnimal cookies dipped in pink candy melts, with a bowl of whipped creamHow to make it125g butter, soft80g caster sugar250g plain flour250g pink or white candy melts2 tbsp sprinkles300ml thickened creamHeat the oven to 170°C. Mix the butter, sugar and flour to a dough, roll and cut animal shapes.Bake until pale golden, then cool.Melt the candy melts, dip each biscuit half and add sprinkles.Whip the cream and serve in a bowl alongside.DrinksDrillers' whiskey ginger highballBourbon, lime and bitters topped with ginger beerHow to make it180ml bourbon2 limes600ml ginger beer4 dashes of aromatic bitters1 bag iceFill four highball glasses with ice.Add bourbon, a squeeze of lime and a dash of bitters to each.Top with cold ginger beer, stir once from the bottom and garnish with a lime wedge.
